technical.summary: Mixed short-term bullish momentum (RSI, Supertrend, PSAR) conflicted by weak intermediate trend structure (below 50/200 MAs) and overbought oscillators; moderate confluence with elevated risk.

fundamental.summary: HD shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 43 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 17) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed with no conviction signal; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (322.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational earnings, and earnings event in 43 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI 9, Supertrend, PSAR bullish) + extreme fear contrarian signal + price near support (249.95) create tactical entry opportunity for swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), price below all major moving averages (50/200 SMA/EMA), overbought oscillators, high earnings risk in 43 days, and zero fundamental conviction make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI 9, Supertrend, PSAR) and extreme fear contrarian signal offer tactical entry near support; however, severe macro headwinds and high earnings risk in 43 days warrant caution.
